snippet.title: Gallipoli - Release Date Reveal Trailer | Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X|S & Epic
snippet.description:
EDIT: The release date of Gallipoli has been delayed due to a technical issue. A new date is TBD.

Read the full delay announcement: http://youtube.com/post/UgkxvEVg4330S3F_6doBNI_CurLUWeGcZI1t

Gallipoli is a new authentic FPS game set on the Ottoman Fronts of WW1! Land on the beaches of Anzac Cove or siege the town of Kut Al Amara in Mesopotamia. Gallipoli brings the most immersive WW1 FPS battles yet with historical classes and authentic weaponry.

Gallipoli releases on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Microsoft PC and Epic Games Store. Add Gallipoli to your wishlist to support us and be notified of the release!

For more details, check out the blog: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3065940/view/499478556610396349

Wishlist now on: 
Steam: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipSteamRelAnnTrailer
PlayStation: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipPSRelAnnTrailer
Xbox: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipXboxRelAnnTrailer
Epic Games Store: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipEpicRelAnnTrailer

Also, don't forget to like and subscribe to our YouTube channel! 
---------------------------------------------
For more information, please visit our website: https://www.ww1gameseries.com/
